Read `AGENTS.md` before changing this repository

Before changing implementation code, execute the hard pre-coding workflow in `Starter-Prompt.md`

Coding starts only when it reports:

```text
DESK STATUS: READY
```

The coding desk requires `find-skills`, Pack82 at 82/82, the 21st CLI, `npx @21st-dev/cli install-skill`, relevant process skills, repository toolchain checks, and planned verification

For UI work, establish 21st.dev access using `docs/agents/21ST_AGENT_SETUP.md` and follow `docs/components/21ST_COMPONENT_WORKFLOW.md`

Use the existing AthR Component Bank and 21st search before custom UI implementation

Keep real 21st credentials outside tracked files and use `API_KEY_21ST`, OAuth, or local CLI login
